description: This file defines the CognitoIdentityClient class in the Aws\CognitoIdentity namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for interacting with Amazon Cognito Identity service, including methods for managing identities and identity pools, and handling asynchronous operations.

classes.name: CognitoIdentityClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon Cognito Identity service, providing methods for identity and identity pool management, with support for synchronous and asynchronous calls.

methods.name: createIdentityPool
methods.description: Creates a new identity pool in Amazon Cognito.

methods.name: createIdentityPoolAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new identity pool.

methods.name: deleteIdentities
methods.description: Deletes one or more identities from the identity pool.

methods.name: getCredentialsForIdentityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves credentials for an identity.

methods.name: getIdentityPoolRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles associated with an identity pool.

methods.name: getIdentityPoolRolesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves roles for an identity pool.

methods.name: getOpenIdToken
methods.description: Obtains an OpenID token for an identity.

methods.name: getOpenIdTokenForDeveloperIdentity
methods.description: Gets an OpenID token for a developer identity.

methods.name: getOpenIdTokenForDeveloperIdentityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets an OpenID token for a developer identity.

methods.name: getPrincipalTagAttributeMapAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves principal tag attribute mappings.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: lookupDeveloperIdentityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up a developer identity.

methods.name: setIdentityPoolRoles
methods.description: Sets roles for an identity pool.

methods.name: setIdentityPoolRolesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets roles for an identity pool.

methods.name: setPrincipalTagAttributeMapAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets principal tag attribute mappings.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
